wikidata.note: agent-checked 2026-10-28 (travel-researcher): label 'Skaftafell', lieu-dit, P625 43 m from the Skaftafellsstofa visitor centre (OSM way/200175906); needs a person's check

draw.note: Designation (parent): Vatnajökull National Park (since 2008), registered as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2019; a national park in its own right from 1967. The Wikidata signals under-score it because the item is a lieu-dit with few language editions.

standing.note: The best-known area of the park's southern side.

distinction.note: Glacier tongues, Svartifoss and birch woods within short walks.

easy_payoff.note: The visitor centre and the Svartifoss and glacier-tongue trails start at the car park.

weather.note: The glaciers and peaks need clear weather.

records.why: Hiking hub of Vatnajökull National Park in Öræfi: Svartifoss, glacier tongues, Morsárdalur.

access_cost.note: No booking or permit is named on the park page; OSM marks the car park as paid (fee=yes), which was not confirmed on a park fee page (the fee page URL returned 404).
